prerequisites: See valid SPO Part A and Part B MECB

learning_outcomes.text: Students demonstrate in their Bachelor's theses that they are able to independently process a problem scientifically and methodically within a given deadline.
Demonstrate and analyze the state of the art.
Apply methods learned during studies to process a scientific question.

syllabus_topics: Independent processing of a topic from mechatronics. The contents of the study are applied here in a comprehensive form. It can be an independent processing of a practical problem or a partial work from a team's field of work, whereby the share of one's own contribution must be clearly evident.
